title: Cone Flyers Mercenaries
description:
CONE FLYERS MERCENARIES!!!The prequel to everyone's favourite survival game: cones in space, see what epic challenges the cones faced before their debut..

Embark on an epic space odyssey...Journey through the mysterious and dangerous Clud Quadrant in hopes of finding an ancient treasure trillions of years old, its location can only be revealed through discovering cryptic documents hidden throughout the cosmos.

Features:Epic Spaceships!

Fly your cone ship to many unique and colourful planets of the Clud Quadrant But be careful! Many hostile alien creatures may try to shoot down your ship, you must defend it!

-collect oil to speed up your ship!

-perform maintenance on ship systems or get help from your crewmates!

-choose the right loadout for the job!

-Collect items from distant planets to upgrade your ship!

Dungeons!

There are many treacherous dungeons, defeat enemies and bosses in order to secure items for your boss, Papa Corporal Cone

-25 dungeons to explore, each with unique themes and challenges!

-Fight your way through a variety of dungeons full of dangerous beasts and bosses!

-Many dungeons include unique challenges you must face!

Interactive weapon system!

There are many different weapons in Cone Flyers Mercenaries, each producing unique and exciting weapon combinations

-Choose a primary and secondary weapon combo

-Choose the right tool for the job! Some weapons may not work well for some situations

-Unlock new and exciting weapons as you progress through the game!

Precision Platforming

Test your reflexes and motor skills over and over again with this game's precision platforming! Your knowledge on game mechanics will be tested with the unique challenges you'll face on each planet

-Use weapons to your advantage! 

-No obnoxiously long respawn animations, so you'll be back to kickin in no time!

-Trial and error.. some of these screens will take you a really long time.

What are you waiting for? This game simply has everything! And remember.. The Life Engine awaits...
description_short: Welcome to Cone Flyers Mercenaries! Fight many dangerous enemies, delve into deep dungeons, and pilot your cone ship with precision platforming and a unique combat system in this tough as nails bullet hell.
